faq_heading: College Park condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in College Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

College Park, Port Moody: 18 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 22%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 3 of 11 Port Moody communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in College Park fell from 25 in June to 18 in September (−28.0%), and 16 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 9.4% of Port Moody’s 192 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in College Park?
College Park also had 14 houses listed and 2 sold in September, against 18 condos and townhomes listed. The College Park houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in College Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 condos and townhomes listed in College Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is College Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in College Park had a sales ratio of 22%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in College Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 16 condos and townhomes sold in College Park over those 4 months, out of 141 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
